title: Speaking ASR result
description: Response of the AI service (Python) for ONE audio answer of IELTS Speaking: Whisper transcript, speech features and optional pronunciation scores. The service only needs the audio file as input; the Part and the question are used later by the grader. This is the input of the Speaking grader (see speaking_feedback.schema.json). Estimated values for learning support.

asr_model.description: Model that produced the transcript, e.g. whisper-small.

language.description: Detected or configured language code, e.g. en.

transcript.description: Text of the answer as recognised by the ASR. May be empty when no speech is detected; the backend rejects very short transcripts before calling the LLM.

pronunciation.description: Pronunciation scores (Azure Pronunciation Assessment). null when it was not run or failed; the grader must still work without it.

duration_sec.description: Length of the whole audio, in seconds.

word_count.description: Number of whitespace-separated words in the transcript.

speech_rate_wpm.description: word_count / duration_sec * 60 (words per minute over the whole audio, pauses included).

pause_count.description: Number of pauses: silences of at least 0.5 s between two consecutive words.

total_pause_sec.description: Total length of all pauses, in seconds.

longest_pause_sec.description: Length of the longest pause, in seconds (0 when there is none).

accuracy.description: How close the sounds are to a native speaker's (0-100).

fluency.description: How natural the rhythm and the silences between words are (0-100).

completeness.description: Share of the expected words that were actually spoken (0-100).

prosody.description: Stress, intonation and rhythm (0-100); null when the service does not provide it.
